sources.observations: Hotel brown panels, granite columns and continuous metal canopy; north corner plaster and broad ground windows.

White three-storey frontage with grouped rectangular windows, dark plinth, east garage and flat-topped dormers. Narrow red gabled house with four sash windows and yellow gate west. Low half-timbered house to east.
North frontage cream plaster with pilasters, western gable, ochre timber intermediate part and taller greenish eastern facade, rear red metal upper storey.

limitations: Photo-informed architectural interpretation. Heights, hidden elevations, exact subdivisions and ornamental profiles estimated. No Google images used as textures.
